rootCause.summary: Session lived under four cookie names: own logins (issue-session.ts) wrote all of them, next-auth only __Secure-haccp-online.session-token (prod), while proxy/getServerSession read haccp-online.session-token first. next-auth signOut() in master/partner shells cleared one cookie; the rest kept the session and /login bounced back to /master. After a next-auth login as B, proxy/pages still saw A (prod). Also NextResponse.cookies.set() wiped Set-Cookie lines added via headers.append: /api/auth/logout never cleared ws-shell, logout-all never cleared legacy names.

AC1.evidence: evidence/after/results.json — 14 login-path × logout-button scenarios (S01–S13), every logout-* check: no session cookies, next-auth and getServerSession see nobody, /login 200, /dashboard and /master 307 to a sign-in screen; master cabinet logout S02/S07/S09; route unit tests for /api/auth/logout and /api/kiosk/lock (production and development attributes).

AC2.evidence: S14 (master password → owner password), S15 (Telegram/next-auth → owner personal QR), S16 (mini phone → master password): next-auth, pages and proxy all see B, one session cookie; src/proxy.test.ts (6 tests, production and dev cookie naming, real JWTs).

AC3.evidence: S02 desktop profile menu, S04 phone profile sheet, S07 mini-app profile: master cabinets only in «Кабинет», not in «Организации»; tap opens /master; «Моя организация» in /master returns to /dashboard; backoffice user has no return item (S09); cabinet-menu.test.ts.

AC4.evidence: npm run typecheck: 0 errors; npm test: 2578 pass / 0 fail; pre-commit hook of ee78ae4d: secrets, typecheck, test:gate pass=2578 fail=0; eslint on changed files clean.
